alignments.note: The ASV writes a bare 'Love' with no determiner, so the article has no English realization (rules 23, 51).

'suffereth long' renders the single compound verb; head on the verb word 'suffereth' rather than the adverbial 'long', as rule 106 heads a compound on its verbal root word. Heading on 'long' as the element answering to the μακρο- prefix remains defensible.

Copula is a rule 7/9 helper; head on the lexical predicate 'kind' (rule 17).

The reflexive 'itself' is the middle verb's own rule 7 helper and rides inside its unit, discontinuously across the intervening 'not' under rule 15; head on the lexical verb.

'is puffed up' renders the one passive verb; the copula is a rule 9 helper, 'up' realizes the preverbal φυσιο- idiom's particle, and the head is the lexical verb word 'puffed' (rules 17, 106). Discontinuity across 'not' is permitted by rule 15.

review_notes: Three occurrences of the article before ἀγάπη are each their own unrepresented unit, the ASV giving 'love' no determiner anywhere in the verse (rule 23); they are not grouped with their nouns (rule 13).

The supplied 'and' at t004 is added under rule 98 rather than folded as a rule 88 juncture: no circumstantial participle is converted here, only two coordinate finite verbs at an asyndetic seam, which is 2CO.3.7's shape.
Each οὐ is aligned to its own 'not'; no negative indefinite stands in the verse, so rules 41 and 59 are not in question.
